name: ShiMamaProtocol executePairBurn without access control
summary: ShiMamaProtocol.executePairBurn(referenceIn,minPull,deadline) is callable by anyone and sizes the pull from the caller-supplied referenceIn; it makes ShiMamaToken.forcePullFromPair move that many ShiMama out of the ShiMama/FlapTaxToken PancakeSwap pair, syncs and burns them. The attacker pulled 1,311,349,143.96 ShiMama (all but 21.54) from the pair and sold 30.78 pre-acquired ShiMama into the collapsed reserve for 14.88M of the pair's quote token, which it sold for 52.98 WBNB.
notes: Direct immutable protocol contract; the owner's initial wiring ShiMamaToken.setProtocol(0x5049d103) (0x44cf1fed04175fa1652973f631ec36e45f0c053916272ffb729f8bb55b2b76b7, block 87272725, 626 blocks later) only makes the deployed protocol operational and supplies no erroneous value.

The ShiMama/FlapTaxToken pair 0x564cb2bae0b35cfc8c77d94d65015fe898f8f927 lost 14,878,507.234647819132575456 of its quote token 0xaff08796 in the anchor transaction: 743,925.36 went to the quote token's own tax and 14,134,581.87 were sold by the attacker into the 0xaff08796/WBNB pair for 52.981232710993276266 WBNB. Only the sold portion is counted, valued at those realised proceeds and the DefiLlama WBNB price; the 30.78 ShiMama the attacker sold into the pair are its own input.
